title: Plot Armor
description: Adds Plot Relevancy- I I mean Plot Armor
body:
## Plot Relevancy

* Adds Plot Relevancy- i mean Plot Armor from the STABL- i mean UNSTABLE SMP

Good uses in Scripted Servers

(NOT FULLY TESTED, THERE MAYBE BUGS)

### Commands

- `/plot <player> - Plots a player making them unkillable`
- `/unplot <player> - self explanitory`
- `/deathban <true|false> - enable/disables deathbanning`
- `/proximitymessages <true|false> - enabled proximity death/leave/join messages`

### Features

* **Plot** - Makes a player unkillable by making their very lowest possible heart, a half a heart (Has a Feature where if you hold a totem while plotted, the totem would pop)
* **DeathBan** - Enabled Death Banning, there are 3 modes, -1 for Permanent Banning, -2 Kicks on death, -3 Only makes a sound when killing a player
* **Proximity Messages** - Makes it so that a player within range of a player dying (configurable of the range), makes it show the death/leave/join messages, but if not within that range, it would not show

There is a Config.yml but im lazy to add it here
